Name: FIRST20 rejected after first completed booking without a discount
Description: PRD footnote 2: FIRST20 is invalid after any first completed booking in the session, whether or not it was used on that booking. Covers the gap in T012, which uses FIRST20 on booking 1. Verify rejection and unchanged full price on booking 2 after booking 1 without entering any discount code.
Preconditions: Documented fresh Encore guest session with zero completed bookings. Available Standard seats. Do not enter or apply any code on booking 1. Keep the same session across both bookings; do not restart, reinstall or clear data. Record base prices and confirmation IDs.
Test Steps (Steps): 1. Select an available Standard seat, record its base price, skip the discount field without entering any code, and complete mocked payment. Expected: confirmation and My Bookings show the full price with no discount.
2. Without restarting, start another booking with a different available Standard seat; record base price P. Expected: selected seat and subtotal match P.
3. Enter FIRST20 and tap Apply. Expected: code is rejected as ineligible with an inline error; no applied discount.
4. Continue to payment. Expected: checkout remains available, discount is zero, total equals P (not 0.8 × P).
5. Complete mocked payment and open My Bookings. Expected: second booking is recorded at P; both confirmation IDs are present in the same session. Capture screenshots and actual results.
